    {
      "kind": "cross-set-association",
      "words": [
        "Nest",
        "Bird",
        "Den",
        "Bear"
      ],
      "severity": "low",
      "note": "Strong nature gravity with Seed and Tree; a player may try to group all four nature words before noticing the relations differ."
    },
    {
      "kind": "ambiguous-order",
      "words": [
        "Nest",
        "Bird"
      ],
      "severity": "medium",
      "note": "Bird : Nest reads as naturally as Nest : Bird, so the direction has to be inferred from the other pair."
    }
  ],
  "crossReadings": [
    {
      "setId": "set-growth",
      "reading": [
        "Seed",
        "Spark",
        "Tree",
        "Fire"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Seed and Spark are both small beginnings and Tree and Fire are both large outcomes, but neither half carries a relationship \u2014 being the same kind of thing is not a relationship."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-growth",
      "reading": [
        "Seed",
        "Fire",
        "Tree",
        "Spark"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Seed : Fire is nothing at all; the two halves are unrelated."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-tools",
      "reading": [
        "Painter",
        "Sculptor",
        "Brush",
        "Chisel"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Two artists set beside two tools; each half is a category pairing rather than a relationship, so there is nothing to repeat."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-tools",
      "reading": [
        "Painter",
        "Chisel",
        "Brush",
        "Sculptor"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Both halves cross the trades \u2014 a painter does not work with a chisel \u2014 so neither pair holds."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-homes",
      "reading": [
        "Nest",
        "Den",
        "Bird",
        "Bear"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Two dwellings and then two animals. A player might notice the symmetry, but a shared category is not a shared relationship and the reveal would not satisfy."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-homes",
      "reading": [
        "Nest",
        "Bear",
        "Bird",
        "Den"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Nest : Bear inverts the dwelling relationship the board teaches; it reads as a mistake, not a reading."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-seasons",
      "reading": [
        "Spring",
        "Autumn",
        "Sowing",
        "Harvest"
      ],
      "valid": true,
      "note": "This one holds: spring is to autumn as sowing is to harvest \u2014 the opening and closing of the same growing year, on both sides. A player would submit it and be marked wrong."
    },
    {
      "setId": "set-seasons",
      "reading": [
        "Spring",
        "Harvest",
        "Sowing",
        "Autumn"
      ],
      "valid": false,
      "note": "Spring : Harvest skips the middle of the year and Sowing : Autumn runs the other way; the halves do not agree."
    }
  ]
}
